newsitem.title: USA: Giant says completed NGL deal with Amoco.
newsitem.headline: Giant says completed NGL deal with Amoco.

text.p: Giant Industries Inc said on Tuesday it completed a long-term supply deal with Amoco Oil Co. for the delivery of natural gasoline and other natural gas liquids (NGLs) to its New Mexico refineries.

"This contract represents another step toward achieving one of our strategic goals of securing stable supplies of raw materials for our two refineries," said Jim Acridge, Giant's chairman and chief executive officer.
The deal calls for Amoco to provide Giant with around 500 barrels-per-day (BPD) of natural gasoline from its Wingate Fractionation Plant near Gallup, N.M..
Giant will use the natural gasoline at its Ciniza refinery, located near Gallup, or at its Bloomfield refinery located in Bloomfield, N.M.
The deal runs from September 1, 1996 through May 31, 1997 with the option for Giant to obtain more natural gasoline through 2001.
Acridge said the company needs about 4,000 bpd of natural gasoline and around 700 bpd of isobutane, all of which are now supplied under long-term deals of five years or more.
The Amoco pact provides a secure incremental supply when required.
"Our demand for natural gasoline and isobutane could more than double over the next several years if certain capital projects are undertaken," Acridge said.
